figs.name: npn-and-pnp-proximity-sensors-wiring-diagram
figs.alt: NPN and PNP proximity sensor wiring diagram with brown, black and blue wires and load
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing PNP and NPN 3 wire proximity sensor wiring: brown to plus 24 V, blue to 0 V and the load on the black output wire.
figs.after_h2: Standard Wire Colors in 3-Wire Proximity Sensors

figs.name: npn-and-pnp-proximity-sensors-field-test-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to identify NPN or PNP proximity sensor with a multimeter field test
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the multimeter test to identify a sensor: measure black to blue and watch whether the output rises to 24 V or falls to 0 V.
figs.after_h2: How to Identify NPN or PNP Sensor in the Field
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Field test flowchart to identify an NPN or PNP sensor with a multimeter</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Is It NPN or PNP? Multimeter Field Test</text>
<rect x="230" y="60" width="340" height="50" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="91.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Power sensor with 24 V DC</text>
<line x1="400" y1="110" x2="400" y2="128" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="180" y="128" width="440" height="50" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="159.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Meter on DC volts: black to blue (0 V)</text>
<line x1="400" y1="178" x2="400" y2="196" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="230" y="196" width="340" height="50" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="227.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Bring a metal target near</text>
<line x1="400" y1="246" x2="400" y2="262" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,264.0 550.0,312 400,360.0 250.0,312" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="307.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reading</text>
<text x="400" y="329.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">changes?</text>
<line x1="250" y1="312" x2="175" y2="312" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="15" y="285" width="160" height="54" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95.0" y="318.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0 V to 24 V</text>
<line x1="95" y1="340" x2="95" y2="380" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="25" y="380" width="140" height="54" rx="10" fill="#ea580c" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95.0" y="414.7" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PNP</text>
<line x1="550" y1="312" x2="625" y2="312" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="625" y="285" width="160" height="54" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="705.0" y="318.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">24 V to 0 V</text>
<line x1="705" y1="340" x2="705" y2="380" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="635" y="380" width="140" height="54" rx="10" fill="#9a3412" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="705.0" y="414.7" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NPN</text>
<line x1="400" y1="360" x2="400" y2="400" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="220" y="400" width="360" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="429.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No change</text>
<text x="400.0" y="453.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">check supply, target and range</text>
<text x="400" y="510" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Tip: the LED on the sensor should light when the target is detected.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: npn-and-pnp-proximity-sensors-selection-infographic
figs.alt: how to choose NPN or PNP sensor for sinking or sourcing PLC input card
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to pick a sensor type: PNP for input cards with common at 0 V and NPN for cards with common at plus 24 V.
figs.after_h2: How to Choose Between NPN and PNP Sensors
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 480" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Selection chart to choose NPN or PNP sensor for a PLC input card</title>
<rect width="800" height="480" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which Sensor Does Your PLC Card Need?</text>
<rect x="40" y="70" width="330" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="124.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC input common at 0 V</text>
<text x="205.0" y="149.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sinking input card</text>
<rect x="430" y="70" width="330" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="124.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC input common at +24 V</text>
<text x="595.0" y="149.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sourcing input card</text>
<line x1="205" y1="190" x2="205" y2="230" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="595" y1="190" x2="595" y2="230" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="90" y="230" width="230" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ea580c" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="263.85" font-size="21" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Use PNP</text>
<text x="205.0" y="290.85" font-size="21" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sourcing sensor</text>
<rect x="480" y="230" width="230" height="80" rx="10" fill="#9a3412" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="263.85" font-size="21" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Use NPN</text>
<text x="595.0" y="290.85" font-size="21" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sinking sensor</text>
<text x="205" y="350" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Common in India and Europe</text>
<text x="595" y="350" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Common in Japan and parts of Asia</text>
<rect x="40" y="380" width="720" height="70" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="410" font-size="18" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wrong pairing means the input LED never lights, even when</text>
<text x="400" y="436" font-size="18" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">the sensor itself switches correctly.</text>
</svg>
